# OpenKB Multi-Attachment Handoff Fixture

Offline, redacted fixture for a Zotero item with multiple attachments:

- two PDF attachments that produce separate handoff and OpenKB import rows;
- one non-PDF attachment represented as an explicit skip outcome.

The fixture contains no PDFs, authenticated URLs, provider payloads, OCR text,
source-pack content, API keys, real paper titles, or local machine paths.
